items.jp: 弟は宿題をめんどうがる

translation.pt-BR: Meu irmão mais novo acha o dever de casa um saco.
translation.en: My younger brother finds homework a pain.

items.label: direct-object marker
items.explanation: を marks 宿題 as what he finds a pain (the object of めんどうがる).

items.jp: 薬を飲んで具合がよくなりました

translation.pt-BR: Tomei o remédio e melhorei.
translation.en: I took the medicine and got better.

items.label: direct-object marker
items.explanation: を marks 薬 (medicine) as the object of the action 飲む (to take). It is what was taken.

items.jp: 家庭での時間を大切にする

translation.pt-BR: Eu valorizo o tempo em casa, com a família.
translation.en: I value the time at home with my family.

items.label: direct-object marker
items.explanation: を marks 時間 (time) as what is valued by the expression 大切にする.

items.jp: 先生がテストの点を調べている

translation.pt-BR: A professora está conferindo as notas da prova.
translation.en: The teacher is checking the test scores.

items.label: direct-object marker
items.explanation: を marks 点 as what is being checked (direct object of 調べる).

items.jp: 今日は髪を切りに行く

translation.pt-BR: Hoje eu vou cortar o cabelo.
translation.en: I'm going to get my hair cut today.

items.label: direct-object marker
items.explanation: を indicates that 髪 is the target of the action 切る ('to cut the hair').

items.jp: 今朝、米を買いに行った

translation.pt-BR: Hoje de manhã fui comprar arroz.
translation.en: This morning I went to buy rice.

items.label: direct-object marker
items.explanation: を marks 米 as that which one is going to buy.
